items.source: Spring AI integrates with Perplexity AI by reusing the existing OpenAI client. To get started, you’ll need to obtain a Perplexity API Key, configure the base URL, and select one of the supported models.
items.translation: Spring AI 通过复用现有的OpenAI客户端与 Perplexity AI 集成。要开始使用，您需要获取一个Perplexity API 密钥，配置基础 URL，并选择一个受支持的模型。

items.source: Create an API Key: Visit here to create an API Key. Configure it using the spring.ai.openai.api-key property in your Spring AI project.
items.translation: 创建 API 密钥： 请访问 此处 创建 API 密钥。 在您的 Spring AI 项目中，使用 spring.ai.openai.api-key 属性进行配置。

items.source: Set the Perplexity Base URL: Set the spring.ai.openai.base-url property to https://api.perplexity.ai.
items.translation: 设置困惑度基础 URL： 将 spring.ai.openai.base-url 属性设置为 https://api.perplexity.ai。

items.source: Select a Perplexity Model: Use the spring.ai.openai.chat.model=<model name> property to specify the model. Refer to Supported Models for available options.
items.translation: 选择 Perplexity 模型： 使用 spring.ai.openai.chat.model=<模型名称> 属性来指定模型。 有关可用选项，请参阅支持的模型。

items.source: Spring AI provides Spring Boot auto-configuration for the OpenAI Chat Client. To enable it add the following dependency to your project’s Maven pom.xml or Gradle build.gradle build files:
items.translation: Spring AI 为 OpenAI 聊天客户端提供了 Spring Boot 自动配置功能。 要在项目的 Maven `pom.xml` 或 Gradle `build.gradle` 构建文件中启用它，请添加以下依赖：

items.source: One of the supported Perplexity models. Example: llama-3.1-sonar-small-128k-online.
items.translation: 受支持的Perplexity 模型之一。示例：llama-3.1-sonar-small-128k-online。

items.source: A value between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model’s likelihood to talk about new topics. Incompatible with frequency_penalty. Required range: -2 < x < 2
items.translation: -2.0 到 2.0 之间的数值。正值会根据新 token 是否已出现在当前文本中对其进行惩罚，从而提高模型讨论新话题的可能性。与frequency_penalty不兼容。必需范围：-2 < x < 2

items.source: On start-up, the default options can be configured with the OpenAiChatModel(api, options) constructor or the spring.ai.openai.chat.* properties.
items.translation: 启动时，可以通过 `OpenAiChatModel(api, options)` 构造函数或 `spring.ai.openai.chat.*` 属性来配置默认选项。

items.source: Create a new Spring Boot project and add the spring-ai-starter-model-openai to your pom (or gradle) dependencies.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 Spring Boot 项目，并在您的 pom（或 gradle）依赖中添加spring-ai-starter-model-openai。

items.source: Add a application.properties file, under the src/main/resources directory, to enable and configure the OpenAi chat model:
items.translation: 在 `src/main/resources` 目录下添加一个 `application.properties` 文件，以启用并配置 OpenAI 聊天模型：

items.source: This will create a OpenAiChatModel implementation that you can inject into your class. Here is an example of a simple @Controller class that uses the chat model for text generations.
items.translation: 这将创建一个 `OpenAiChatModel` 实现，您可以将其注入到您的类中。以下是一个使用聊天模型进行文本生成的简单 `@Controller` 类的示例。

items.source: Perplexity AI provides a unique AI service that integrates its language models with real-time search capabilities. It offers a variety of models and supports streaming responses for conversational AI.
items.translation: Perplexity AI 提供独特的 AI 服务，将语言模型与实时搜索功能相结合。它提供多种模型，并支持对话式 AI 的流式响应。

items.source: Check the PerplexityWithOpenAiChatModelIT.java tests for examples of using Perplexity with Spring AI.
items.translation: 检查PerplexityWithOpenAiChatModelIT.java测试，以获取使用 Perplexity 与 Spring AI 的示例。

items.source: You can set these configuration properties in your application.properties file:
items.translation: 您可以在 `application.properties` 文件中设置这些配置属性：

items.source: Spring AI artifacts are published in Maven Central and Spring Snapshot repositories. Refer to the Artifact Repositories section to add these repositories to your build system.
items.translation: Spring AI 的构件发布在 Maven Central 和 Spring Snapshot 仓库中。请参考构件仓库部分，以将这些仓库添加到您的构建系统中。

items.source: To help with dependency management, Spring AI provides a BOM (bill of materials) to ensure that a consistent version of Spring AI is used throughout the entire project. Refer to the Dependency Management section to add the Spring AI BOM to your build system.
items.translation: 为便于依赖管理，Spring AI 提供了一个 BOM（物料清单），以确保整个项目中使用的 Spring AI 版本保持一致。请参考依赖管理部分，将 Spring AI BOM 添加到您的构建系统中。

items.source: There has been a significant change in the Spring AI auto-configuration, starter modules' artifact names. Please refer to the upgrade notes for more information.
items.translation: Spring AI 的自动配置中，starter 模块的构件名称已发生重大变更。 有关更多信息，请参阅升级说明。

items.source: The prefix spring.ai.retry is used as the property prefix that lets you configure the retry mechanism for the OpenAI chat model.
items.translation: 前缀 `spring.ai.retry` 用作属性前缀，允许您为 OpenAI 聊天模型配置重试机制。

items.source: If false, throw a NonTransientAiException, and do not attempt retry for 4xx client error codes
items.translation: 如果为假，则抛出 NonTransientAiException 异常，并且不要针对 `<code>4xx` 客户端错误代码进行重试。

items.source: The prefix spring.ai.openai is used as the property prefix that lets you connect to OpenAI.
items.translation: spring.ai.openai 前缀用作连接 OpenAI 的属性前缀。

items.source: The URL to connect to. Must be set to https://api.perplexity.ai
items.translation: 要连接的 URL。必须设置为https://api.perplexity.ai

items.source: Enabling and disabling of the chat auto-configurations are now configured via top level properties with the prefix spring.ai.model.chat.
items.translation: 启用和禁用聊天自动配置现在通过带有前缀spring.ai.model.chat的顶层属性进行配置。

items.source: The prefix spring.ai.openai.chat is the property prefix that lets you configure the chat model implementation for OpenAI.
items.translation: spring.ai.openai.chat 前缀是用于配置 OpenAI 聊天模型实现的属性前缀。

items.source: Optional overrides the spring.ai.openai.base-url to provide chat specific url. Must be set to https://api.perplexity.ai
items.translation: 可选，覆盖 spring.ai.openai.base-url 以提供特定于聊天的 URL。必须设置为https://api.perplexity.ai。

items.source: The amount of randomness in the response, valued between 0 inclusive and 2 exclusive. Higher values are more random, and lower values are more deterministic. Required range: 0 < x < 2.
items.translation: 响应的随机性程度，取值范围为 [0, 2)，包含 0 但不包含 2。较高的值表示更随机，较低的值表示更确定。必需范围：0 < x < 2。

items.source: A multiplicative penalty greater than 0. Values greater than 1.0 penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model’s likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim. A value of 1.0 means no penalty. Incompatible with presence_penalty. Required range: x > 0.
items.translation: 大于 0 的乘法惩罚。大于 1.0 的值会根据文本中现有 token 的频率对新 token 施加惩罚，从而降低模型逐字重复同一行的可能性。值为 1.0 表示无惩罚。与 presence_penalty 不兼容。所需范围：x > 0。

items.source: The nucleus sampling threshold, valued between 0 and 1 inclusive. For each subsequent token, the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. We recommend either altering top_k or top_p, but not both. Required range: 0 < x < 1
items.translation: 核采样阈值，取值范围为 0 到 1（包含）。对于每个后续 token，模型会考虑具有 top_p 概率质量的 token 的结果。我们建议调整 top_k 或 top_p 其中之一，但不要同时调整两者。必需范围：0 < x < 1

items.source: (For streaming only) Set to add an additional chunk with token usage statistics for the entire request. The choices field for this chunk is an empty array and all other chunks will also include a usage field, but with a null value.
items.translation: （仅适用于流式传输）设置为添加一个包含整个请求的令牌使用统计信息的额外块。此块的choices字段为空数组，而所有其他块也将包含一个使用字段，但其值为 null。

items.source: The OpenAiChatOptions.java provides model configurations, such as the model to use, the temperature, the frequency penalty, etc.
items.translation: OpenAiChatOptions.java 提供了模型配置，例如要使用的模型、温度、频率惩罚等。

items.source: At run-time you can override the default options by adding new, request specific, options to the Prompt call. For example to override the default model and temperature for a specific request:
items.translation: 在运行时，您可以通过向 `Prompt` 调用添加新的、特定于请求的选项来覆盖默认选项。 例如，若要针对特定请求覆盖默认的模型和温度：

items.source: Perplexity supports several models optimized for search-enhanced conversational AI. Refer to Supported Models for details.
items.translation: Perplexity 支持多种针对搜索增强型对话人工智能优化的模型。有关详细信息，请参阅支持的模型。

items.source: The maximum number of completion tokens returned by the API. The total number of tokens requested in max_tokens plus the number of prompt tokens sent in messages must not exceed the context window token limit of model requested. If left unspecified, then the model will generate tokens until either it reaches its stop token or the end of its context window.
items.translation: API 返回的完成令牌的最大数量。请求的 max_tokens 中的令牌总数加上在 messages 中发送的提示令牌数，不得超过所请求模型的上下文窗口令牌限制。如果未指定，则模型将生成令牌，直到达到其停止令牌或上下文窗口的末尾。

items.source: The Perplexity API is not fully compatible with the OpenAI API. Perplexity combines realtime web search results with its language model responses. Unlike OpenAI, Perplexity does not expose toolCalls - function call mechanisms. Additionally, currently Perplexity doesn’t support multimodal messages.
